external_source: d-n-ust/ai-analytics-harness (MIT). Deterministic warehouse (SEED=42, N_USERS=2500); golds computed by running each question's gold_sql over the clean star — never hand-typed.
axis: grounding (aah rungs 1-6), orthogonal to the delegation dial; see approach_docs/015

graders.numeric: extract a number from the answer text; correct if within tolerance (a rate answered as % is accepted)
graders.keywords: answer names the right metric (any gold keyword present)
graders.diagnostic: answer identifies the right driver AND the root cause
